exposure: Duration of skin-to-skin contact (<15 min, 15-90 min, >90 min)
cohort: The study included 1812 mothers from multi-center Vietnam whose infants were aged 0 to less than 30 months.
finding: The prevalence of early initiation of breastfeeding was 57.2%, and factors such as female infants, urban living, private hospital birth, vaginal birth, and especially longer durations of skin-to-skin contact were positively associated with it.
mod_finding: Vaginal birth was associated with increased odds of early initiation of breastfeeding (aOR: 1.70; 95%CI: 1.34 to 2.16).
cross-section timing: The survey was conducted among mothers whose infants were aged 0 to less than 30 months, retrospectively assessing early initiation of breastfeeding.
